desc:
This is the single-player version for Destroy the Hotel.
Tired of playing alone? Play the multiplayer version with friends! https://www.roblox.com/games/626165506/Destroy-the-Hotel

Use the purple regeneration button to regenerate the hotel. It's located to the right of the hotel.
Credits to:
Waterlimon (Creator of Disaster Hotel, play his game)
Yoshi8080 for scripting certain stuff.

To use the gear spawner, insert the ID of the gear from the catalog. (e.g. "/catalog/XX/InsertGearHere" with XX being the ID)
